!62 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"//==========================================================================//\0A// This shader is a minimal, complete reproduction of DXC issue #5476: a compute\0A// shader with a [RootSignature(...)] attribute on its entry point, compiled with\0A// `-fcgl` (dump unoptimized codegen).\0A//\0A// What to check in each pane: the `!dx.rootSignature = !{...}` metadata near the\0A// end, and the byte-array constant a few lines above it (a `[92 x i8] c\22...\22`\0A// string holding the *serialized* root signature blob). Both panes here should\0A// compile cleanly (exit 0) and print the *complete* IR text, including that\0A// byte array.\0A//\0A// That is expected and does NOT resolve the issue. #5476 is reported only on\0A// macOS/Linux consoles: dxc's cross-platform \22write UTF-8 text to the console\22\0A// helper round-trips through Unicode::UTF8BufferToWideBuffer, which on\0A// non-Windows platforms calls the C library's mbstowcs() after trying to switch\0A// the process locale to a UTF-8 one -- and the reporter's Actual Behavior is\0A// that this conversion silently fails on their machine, so nothing is printed\0A// at all. Compiler Explorer's Linux build environment apparently always has a\0A// working UTF-8 locale available, so it can never show the failure regardless\0A// of whether the underlying bug is fixed -- a clean pane here is a property of\0A// CE's environment, not evidence about the reported machine's environment or\0A// about whether the fix (main commit 9bcce409b, PR #7506, merged 2025-11-25)\0A// actually resolves it there. See notes.md for the full reasoning and its\0A// limits.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0AStructuredBuffer<matrix> buf1;\0ARWBuffer<float4> buf2;\0A\0A[RootSignature(\22DescriptorTable(SRV(t0), UAV(u0))\22)]\0A[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]\0Avoid main(uint3 tid : SV_DispatchThreadID) {\0A  buf2[tid.x] = buf1[tid.x][tid.y];\0A}\0A"}
